artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the screen is illegible and blob-like, typical of AI generation struggling with fine typography, though it mimics the layout of an OS.
The individual keys on the lower keypad lack clear separation and distinct geometric shapes; they appear to melt into each other or the casing, lacking the crisp edges of real physical buttons.
The skin texture on the fingers holding the device is overly smooth and lacks pore detail, with slight blurring at the boundaries where the fingers touch the device.
The circular navigation pad appears slightly elliptical and unevenly thick, suggesting minor warping inconsistent with a rigid manufactured object.

selected_experts.reason: To verify if the device is correctly classified as a hand-held computer/PDA and not misidentified as a generic phone or remote.
To analyze the legibility and structure of the text on the screen, checking for AI-specific gibberish artifacts.
To check if the physical buttons are distinct, separate entities or if they suffer from fusion/melting artifacts.
To assess general sharpness, noise, and structural coherence of the device and hand.

focus_areas: Legibility and semantic correctness of screen UI elements
Geometric integrity and separation of physical keypad buttons
Boundary sharpness between the device casing and the holding hand
Symmetry and rigidity of the central navigation pad
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the keypad area. AI generators often fail to render distinct, functional-looking physical keys, resulting in 'mushy' or fused button clusters. Also, scrutinize the screen text; while it should look like an OS, AI often produces pseudo-text that fails OCR or logical layout tests. Check if the hand holding the device has natural anatomical proportions and skin texture, as hands are common failure points.
